purpose: General-education situation reference; not a personal eligibility or deadline engine

situations.situation: First eligible at 65: Part B or premium-Part A
situations.window: Generally three months before the birthday month, that month and three months after.
situations.action: Enroll in Part B and, if needed, premium-Part A.
situations.coverage_start: Before the eligibility month: that month. During or after it within the IEP: next month.
situations.checks: First-day birthday shifts the clock. Automatic enrollment and earlier disability/ALS/ESRD eligibility need separate handling.
situations.example_query: What is my initial enrollment period?

situations.situation: First eligible at 65 with a birthday on the first
situations.window: Four months before the birthday month through two months after it.
situations.action: Use the shifted initial enrollment window.
situations.coverage_start: Generally the first of the month before the birthday month, subject to the part and enrollment timing.
situations.checks: Late Part B is not automatically backdated. Use the existing deterministic date helper for personal dates.
situations.example_query: What if my birthday is the first of the month?

situations.situation: Eligible for premium-free Part A at 65
situations.window: Initial enrollment or any time later once eligible.
situations.coverage_start: Generally the age-65 eligibility month; later applications can be retroactive up to six months, no earlier than initial eligibility.
situations.checks: First-day birthdays shift eligibility. HSA contributions require separate attention to retroactive coverage.
situations.example_query: How does premium free Part A start?

situations.situation: First Medicare Advantage or standalone Part D plan
situations.window: Initial plan-enrollment opportunity around first Medicare eligibility; generally seven months for age-65 eligibility.
situations.action: Join MA with both A and B, or standalone Part D with A or B.
situations.coverage_start: A request before required Medicare starts takes effect with it; a request after generally starts the month after plan receipt.
situations.checks: Plan service area and prerequisites apply. This is separate from signing up for Parts A and B.
situations.example_query: When can I join my first drug plan?

situations.window: For the ordinary disability route, three months before the 25th benefit month through three months after it.
situations.action: A/B are generally automatic; make separate health/drug-plan choices if applicable.
situations.coverage_start: Generally the 25th month of benefit entitlement, or age 65 if earlier; plan start follows its own request timing.
situations.checks: Not 24 months after diagnosis or application. ALS and ESRD differ.
situations.example_query: How does Medicare disability work after 24 months?

situations.window: The ordinary 24-month Medicare waiting period is waived; confirm the entitlement notice and plan opportunity.
situations.action: Receive Medicare through the ALS disability pathway; plan selection remains separate.
situations.checks: Diagnosis alone does not establish an award or effective date.
situations.example_query: Does ALS require a Medicare waiting period?

situations.window: Separate ESRD eligibility and application rules; do not substitute the age-65 IEP or work SEP.
situations.action: Apply based on qualifying treatment and work/benefit record.
situations.coverage_start: Usually the fourth dialysis month; qualifying home training or transplant circumstances can allow an earlier start.
situations.checks: No personal date calculated. Payer coordination is a separate 30-month rule with prior-primary exceptions.
situations.example_query: What are the ESRD eligibility rules?

situations.situation: Delayed Part B while covered through current employment
situations.window: After the IEP: while qualifying group coverage continues, or eight months after employment or coverage ends, whichever is first.
situations.action: Enroll in Part B under a qualifying work SEP without a late penalty.
situations.coverage_start: Generally next month; while still working or within the first full month after coverage ends, a start delayed up to three months may be requested.
situations.checks: COBRA/retiree coverage does not extend it. Disability family-member coverage needs large-group status. Not the ESRD rule or a Part D deadline.
situations.example_query: How does the eight month window work?

situations.situation: Missed initial Part B or premium-Part A enrollment
situations.window: General Enrollment Period: January 1–March 31 each year, unless a qualifying SEP provides another route.
situations.action: Enroll in Part B and/or premium-Part A.
situations.checks: A late penalty may apply; do not assume no SEP or exemption without the coverage history.
situations.example_query: What is the general enrollment period?

situations.situation: Annual Medicare health/drug-plan selection or changes
situations.action: Join, switch or drop eligible MA/Part D coverage, including changing between Original Medicare and MA.
situations.coverage_start: January 1 of the following year if the plan receives the request by December 7.
situations.checks: This window does not itself permit first Part B enrollment or guarantee Medigap. A person's IEP or SEP can independently overlap these dates.

situations.action: One change to another MA plan or to Original Medicare, with an opportunity to join separate Part D.
situations.coverage_start: First of the month after the plan receives the request.
situations.checks: Not a route from Original Medicare into MA or a general standalone Part D switch window. Medigap and Medical Savings Account plan rules are separate.
situations.example_query: When does an MA open enrollment change start?

situations.situation: Joined MA when first eligible for Medicare
situations.window: First three months with Parts A and B for the new-beneficiary MA open-enrollment opportunity.
situations.action: Change MA plans or return to Original Medicare, with a separate drug-plan opportunity.
situations.coverage_start: Generally first of the month after plan receipt.
situations.checks: Separate trial rights may also apply; this row does not adjudicate Medigap rights.
situations.example_query: How does MA OEP work for someone new to Medicare?

situations.situation: Already has Part A and adds Part B later
situations.window: An initial MA opportunity tied to first having both parts; exact closing-date wording needs reconciliation before a personal deadline is given.
situations.action: Join MA during the applicable initial plan window.
situations.coverage_start: With Part B for a request before B starts; generally next month for a request after B starts.
situations.checks: The official webpage and booklet describe the endpoint differently. No exact duration is indexed as accepted wording. This does not reset Part D eligibility or create a Part B SEP.
situations.example_query: What happens when adding Part B later?

situations.window: Plan SEP continues for two full months after the month coverage ends.
situations.action: Join an eligible MA or drug plan.
situations.coverage_start: Generally first of the month after plan receipt.
situations.checks: This is not the work-based Part B SEP. Avoid a 63-day gap in creditable drug coverage; the plan SEP does not automatically waive penalties.
situations.example_query: When COBRA ends drug plan enrollment is available?

situations.situation: Involuntary loss of creditable drug coverage or notice it is no longer creditable
situations.window: Two full months after the month of loss or notification, whichever is later.
situations.action: Join MA with drug coverage or a standalone drug plan, subject to prerequisites.
situations.coverage_start: Generally first of the month after plan receipt.
situations.checks: Keep the notice and actual end date. The 63-day penalty trigger is not the same as this enrollment deadline.
situations.example_query: What does loss of creditable coverage allow?

situations.situation: At least 65 and newly enrolled in Part B
situations.window: Six months beginning with the first month both conditions are met.
situations.action: Buy an available Medigap policy under the federal open-enrollment protection against health-based denial.
situations.coverage_start: Confirm the issued policy's effective date; the buying window itself is not an effective-date promise.
situations.checks: Not annual. Starting B while working can start the clock. Other buying rights and pre-existing-condition questions remain separate; all three Florida holds stay disabled.
situations.example_query: How does the medigap enrollment window work?
